pr_title: Fix tsdb to use errors from the storage package
pr_body:
Make TSDB use storage errors

    This fixes #6992, which was introduced by #6777. There was an
    intermediate component which translated TSDB errors into storage errors,
    but that component was deleted and this bug went unnoticed, until we
    were watching at the Prombench results. Without this, scrape will fail
    instead of dropping samples or using "Add" when the series have been
    garbage collected.

Signed-off-by: Julien Pivotto <roidelapluie@inuits.eu>

Fixes #6992

https://play.golang.org/p/JGcqpSuJ5wG

issue_context.title: 2.17.0-rc.1: err="unknown series:  not found"
issue_context.body:
**What did you do?**

Run Prombench

**What did you expect to see?**

2.17 can scrape the same targets as 2.16

**What did you see instead? Under which circumstances?**

2.17 sometimes fails with:
level=debug ts=2020-03-16T19:18:07.614Z caller=scrape.go:968 component="scrape manager" 
                         scrape_pool=fake-webservers-12 target=http://10.16.50.105:8081/metrics msg="append failed" err="unknown series: 
                         not found"

**Environment**

* System information:
http://prombench.prometheus.io/6991/prometheus-pr/graph?g0.range_input=2h&g0.expr=count_values(%22up%22%2Cup)&g0.tab=0
http://prombench.prometheus.io/grafana/d/7gmLoNDmz/prombench?orgId=1&var-RuleGroup=All&var-pr-number=6991&from=1584377715743&to=1584387589755
![samp](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/291750/76797383-a573ae80-67cd-11ea-94ba-ad1e067e02cd.png)
comments: This is coming from the `AddFast` method (head.go L988). This should never bubble up to that line (because the normal `Add` is used instead if that error happens). Something weird is going on…
And it stays for consecutive scrapes for 30 minutes

It happened in a previous prombench too

![samp2](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/291750/76802397-dfe24900-67d7-11ea-8025-fa7f36cf781b.png)

I guess that has to happen in the `Add` method of the `headAppender`. It creates the series and then call `AddFast` for it, but perhaps it wasn't really created or got removed again or something.

That it stays that way for 30m is really curious…

I'm too tired right now to debug more.
@beorn7 I created a PR, help is appreciated tomorrow to see how we can test that

Fixed by: https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/6993

Thanks @roidelapluie for finding this! :muscle:

review_comments: I think all of this should be `errors.Cause`, so we are safe on potential wraps someday.
